text:
deploy-bot: promotion blocked for release 'payments-api' -> registry digest mismatch between eu-west and us-east. chart payments-api@3.4.0 references image digest sha256:abc123, but eu-west mirror shows sha256:def456. Promotion paused.

grace.release: huh. How did the digest diverge? we mirrored images yesterday.

dan.kube: mirrors sometimes lag; if the registry republished the tag, digest can differ. need to verify image immutability.

platform-sre: quick checks: `skopeo inspect docker://registry.eu-west.example.com/payments-api:2026-03-20 | jq -r .Digest` -> returns sha256:def456
platform-sre: `skopeo inspect docker://registry.us-east.example.com/payments-api:2026-03-20 | jq -r .Digest` -> returns sha256:abc123

alice_prod: product promoted the tag 2026-03-20; we've been using tag-based promotion. This shows tag is not immutable.

release-captain: options: A) abort promotion until registries converge (risk delay), B) pin chart to explicit digest and repush to artifact repo (fast), C) force promote with imageOverride to the us-east digest and add region-specific override (messy). Thoughts?

grace.release: product prefers no delay. pin-and-republish seems safest: publish payments-api@3.4.1 with image.digest set to sha256:abc123 (canonical digest) so all regions pull identical content.

dan.kube: agree. I can republish chart with values override baked in. Need CI to verify image digest is reachable in all regions.

platform-sre: caution: if eu-west cannot access abc123 due to mirror lag, pods will imagepullbackoff. We should confirm replication first, or push to our internal registry with canonical digest.

release-captain: plan: pin chart to digest + repush to artifact repo (3.4.1), run canary at 5% in both regions simultaneously, wait 20m for image pulls & readiness. If canary green -> staged promote. If canary fails due to pull errors -> fallback to rollback to v3.4.0 with tag override to previous known-good digest in that region.

grace.release: who will own the republish and the artifact index update?

dan.kube: I will. steps: 
1) fork charts/payments-api -> bump to 3.4.1 and add values.image.digest: "sha256:abc123"
2) helm lint && helm package -> charts/payments-api-3.4.1.tgz
3) chartmuseum-publish charts/payments-api-3.4.1.tgz && curl -XPOST $ARTIFACTS/refresh-index
4) update release notes and tag release 3.4.1

platform-sre: I'll run `skopeo copy docker://registry.us-east.example.com/payments-api@sha256:abc123 docker://registry.eu-west.example.com/payments-api@sha256:abc123` to ensure the digest exists in eu-west mirror, and verify with skopeo inspect.

release-captain: add a short release note blurb: "fix(release): pin payments-api image to immutable digest to prevent cross-region tag drift (payments-api v3.4.1)". Also add to changelog under 'release ops'.

grace.release: product notified, they prefer simultaneous 5% canaries to detect regional differences.

dan.kube: republish in progress, PR #1987 created with bump and values.digest. Running lint now.

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> hold set by release-captain. Canary targets: payments-api@3.4.1 -> 5% eu-west + 5% us-east.

platform-sre: eu-west copy in progress, currently 60% done. will post when skopeo inspect returns the digest.

release-captain: monitoring owners: @dan.kube for deploy, @grace.release for rollout status, @alice_prod for product signoff. We'll auto-promote after 20m of green. Manual abort if imagepullbackoff or readiness <90%.

platform-sre: eu-west inspect now returns sha256:abc123. mirror good.

dan.kube: canary started at 3456800005. watching pod events and imagepull logs.

grace.release: 10m in, both regions canaries are healthy. no imagepull errors.

alice_prod: product approves full promotion.

release-captain: proceeding with staged promotion across remaining clusters. Note: follow-up action - add policy to artifact-pipeline to require digest-pinned promotions and reject plain tag promotes for prod. filing infra ticket #1120.

deploy-bot: promotion success: payments-api rolled to 3.4.1 across regions at 3456800020. release-captain: please attach release-notes and close the hold. :tada:
